title: Using AI to Build an Infinite Game: Jeff Schomay
talk_summary: Jeff Schomay built a small game where every scene (JSON text plus image) is generated fresh by AI, using a fine-tuned text model to shrink prompts and a custom-trained image model for stylistic consistency. He added a prefill cache so slow generation (10-30s) never blocks the player.

takeaways.technique: Fine-tune a small model to replace a long prompt
takeaways.what_they_do: After prompt-engineering a long detailed prompt, he generated 50 example outputs and fine-tuned a model on them, then shortened the prompt by removing the JSON schema and detailed instructions, relying on the training examples to encode format.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I shortened The Prompt I simplified it I took out any of the Json and just generally described what I wanted
takeaways.numbers: 50 examples; ~$1-2 total for example generation + fine-tuning; 'less tokens in the prompt which is faster and cheaper'

takeaways.what_they_do: He removed the JSON format description from the prompt entirely and let fine-tuning examples carry the output contract; validation still checks keys after generation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: even though I didn't mention the B on it all it came out perfect because of what was in the examples

takeaways.what_they_do: Because generation took 10-30s, he pre-generated a pool of scenes and refilled it whenever it dropped below a threshold, so a ready item was always available.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I prefill a bunch of these scenes and then as scenes are taken out of it I fill it back up again once it gets below a certain threshold

takeaways.technique: Validate generated artifacts before downstream steps
takeaways.what_they_do: The pipeline validates the generated JSON for required keys before sending the description to the image model, so bad generations don't propagate.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I validate the Json to make sure that it's got all the keys it needs if it's good I take the description

takeaways.what_they_do: He built a simple preview server to scroll through many generated scenes and eyeball whether they worked before shipping.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I made a simple preview server so that I could scroll through a bunch of these scenes that I generated to make sure they worked
